integrity: Exact algebraic proof plus standalone rational finite-case replay. Self-review only; no claim of global priority, external certification, or independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns a deterministic isotropic quadratic, iid isotropic orthogonal frames, constant positive radius and step \(0<\alpha\lambda d/\ell<2\); no nonisotropic or noisy-objective extension, complete stationary law, or almost-sure convergence is established. Specialized unindexed prior analyses remain a priority risk.
title: A sharp signed-direction reversal for fixed-radius structured zeroth-order descent
